title: Monthly Interest Posting on Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing Plans Without a Promotion
content:
**Policy.** Monthly interest on an account whose plan carries no promotion is posted once for each statement period whose due date has passed, as a monthly-interest entry naming that period, on the day it is posted. For an account whose plan carries no promotion, and only for such an account, the interest for a statement period is figured on the balance the account carries on the day the interest is posted, at the annual rate and in the manner set out in this policy, in place of the balance at the start of the period and the autopay enrollment at the start of the period; every promotional plan account remains under the base interest rules, and the discount still never makes the rate negative. The plan attributes that describe monthly interest as one twelfth of the effective APR applied to the balance at the start of the statement period, and the autopay discount as a reduction of the effective APR while autopay is enrolled, describe the base interest rules; for an account this policy covers, the balance carried on the posting day, the annual rate and the manner set out in this policy govern.

This policy belongs to Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing. A plan carries no promotion when its promotional period is zero months and its kind of promotion is none.

## What posting does

The interest is booked on the account as a new monthly-interest entry, dated the day it is posted and naming the statement period it is charged for. It raises the amount owed on the account by the interest and shows on the borrower's account history and statement.

## Points of judgement

- One monthly-interest entry per statement period whose due date has passed.
- An account on a promotional plan is not posted under this policy.

## Invocation

The tool is `post_finance_period_interest_067abc59`. It is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `finance_account_id` | The reference number of the financing account the interest is charged to, as returned by the financing account lookup | Identifier |
| `statement_period` | The monthly statement period the interest is charged for | YYYY-MM, four-digit year and two-digit month; never empty |
| `amount` | The interest charged, in USD | A non-negative amount with 2 decimal places; stored rounded to 2 decimal places |

## Return

A successful call returns `finance_txn_id` (the reference number of the new monthly-interest charge), `finance_account_id` (the account charged), `statement_period` (YYYY-MM, the period charged), `amount` (USD with 2 decimal places, the interest booked), `posted_on` (YYYY-MM-DD, the posting date) and `status` (the word posted when the charge was booked).
